dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000s9k6](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000s9k6) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 60.76 depth occurred on Feb 16 2026 118 km SSE of Lata, Solomon Islands. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -11.637 longitude 166.371. It impacted 1446 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
